caption: The drawing depicts a marionette puppet suspended by thin vertical strings. The puppet has a segmented wooden face painted white, with red and black accents marking the cheeks, nose, mouth, and brow. It wears a deep red pointed hat, and a green costume with loose, flowing fabric. The neck area is gray, possibly resembling a collar. The puppet's hands and feet are wooden and jointed, and each wrist and ankle is adorned with redruffled fabric. The hands are positioned at different angles, holding an implied pose. The background is plain and unadorned, and the figure stands out sharply. In the lower right corner, the name "ELMER WEISE" is printed in uppercase black letters. The overall color palette is predominantly green and red, with flesh and wood tones on the face and hands.
title: Jester
